server.description: Server URIs to send inventory results to (e.g., http://example/ocsinventory); supports multiple comma-separated values.

local.description: Local paths to write inventory results (file or directory); supports multiple comma-separated values.

delaytime.description: Maximum delay before first target, in seconds (also caps network error delay); default 3600.

lazy.description: Do not contact target before scheduled time (server targets ignored).

force.description: Always send inventory to server, even if not requested.

no_task.description: List of tasks to skip; comma-separated. Available: inventory, deploy, netdiscovery, wakeup, ...

tasks.description: Tasks to run in order; supports '...' to append remaining tasks.

no_category.description: Inventory categories to skip (e.g., battery, cpu, software, etc.); comma-separated.

scan_homedirs.description: Scan user home directories for virtual machines.

html.description: Save inventory as HTML (only for local output).

backend_collect_timeout.description: Timeout for inventory modules, in seconds.

additional_content.description: Path to additional XML content file (supplements inventory).

no_p2p.description: Disable P2P for package deployment (default: enabled).

proxy.description: HTTP proxy to use (overrides HTTP_PROXY env var).

ca_cert_dir.description: Directory containing CA certificates for SSL verification.

ca_cert_file.description: File containing CA certificates for SSL verification.

no_ssl_check.description: Skip verification of server SSL certificate.

no_compression.description: Disable compression of HTTP communication with server.

httpd_ip.description: Network interface to bind the embedded web server to (e.g., 127.0.0.1, all).

httpd_trust.description: List of trusted IP addresses/CIDRs for HTTP requests (auth token skipped).

listen.description: Enable listener mode (for HTTP responses without local/server targets).

logger.description: Logger backends (stderr, file, syslog); supports multiple.

logfile_maxsize.description: Max log file size in MB; 0 = unlimited.

color.description: Use ANSI colors in console output (stderr logger).

config_backend.description: Configuration backend: file, registry, or none.

conf_file.description: Path to configuration file (used when config_backend = file).

no_fork.description: Do not fork when running as daemon.

pidfile.description: PID file path (for daemon mode, not managed by systemd).

tag.description: Tag appended to every inventory result.

setup.description: Print the agent setup directories and exit.
